globals.clearTemporary.description: Deletes every temporary global variable (the ones that are not saved). Saved ones stay.

globals.delete.returns: true when the variable existed, false when there was nothing to delete.

globals.get.description: Reads a global variable as text, the same way ~name~ shows it in a message.
globals.get.returns: The value as text, or null when there is no such variable.

globals.getValue.description: Reads a global variable and keeps its type, so a number stays a number and true/false stays true/false.
globals.getValue.returns: The value as a number, true/false or text, or null when there is no such variable.

globals.increment.description: Adds to a number in a global variable, like a death counter. A missing variable starts at 0. Fails when the variable holds text that is not a number.

parameters.name: The variable name, like "deaths".
parameters.amount: Optional. How much to add, like 1 or 0.5. Use a negative number to subtract. Leave it out to add 1.
parameters.persisted: Optional. true (the default) saves it so it is still there after a restart; false keeps it only until Cuebot closes.

globals.set.description: Saves a value in a global variable. Every action can read it, and messages can show it with ~name~. The value is stored as text.

parameters.name: The variable name, like "lastRaider".
parameters.value: The value to store, like "CoolStreamer". Numbers and true/false are stored as text.
parameters.persisted: Optional. true (the default) saves it so it is still there after a restart; false keeps it only until Cuebot closes.
